s002: The gloved hands move the scaler slowly along the teeth in small careful strokes, a fine mist spraying; the anaesthetised cat stays still, breathing gently. Slow handheld push-in.
s004: The gloved fingers hold the mouth steady while Mabel's tongue shifts slightly and her whiskers twitch; the gums stay in clear view. Subtle handheld drift, very slow push-in.
s005: Mabel holds her mouth wide open, her tongue curling slightly and her whiskers quivering, the swollen gums staying in clear view. Slow handheld push-in toward the teeth.
s007: Mabel chews slowly and awkwardly on one side, tilting her head, and a biscuit drops from her mouth to the floor; the bowl stays still. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s009: Mabel swats quickly at the reaching hand with her claws and nips at the fingers; the hand flinches back slightly. Slightly shaky handheld camera, no zoom.
s013: The hand slowly moves the toothbrush closer and the black cat pushes it away firmly with its paw, turning its head aside. Gentle handheld drift.
s014: The woman rubs the finger brush gently along the cat's teeth as it squirms and twists its head away; her knees hold it steady. Slight handheld drift.
s015: The hand slowly tips the bottle and a thin trickle of liquid pours into the bowl, sending small ripples across the water. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s016: The scoop slowly tips and a few green biscuits tumble onto the pile and roll to a stop; the tray stays still. Gentle handheld drift.
s018: The scratched arm wiggles the toothbrush gently toward the ginger cat, which stays lying down, blinks slowly and turns its head away. Gentle handheld drift.
s021: The nurse leans in slowly and gently adjusts the cat's head while the anaesthetised cat stays limp, breathing slowly. Gentle handheld drift.
s022: Mabel slowly and stiffly climbs one step higher, pausing with her tail low like an old cat. Steady handheld camera gently follows upward.
s025: The monitor lines sweep slowly across the screen and the numbers flicker; the draped cat rises and falls gently with each breath. Very slow handheld push-in toward the monitor.
s026: Mabel lies still beside the plate, blinking slowly, then lowers her chin onto her paws; the food stays untouched. Low, slow handheld push-in.
s027: The vet gently strokes the kitten with her thumb, lips closed, while it blinks and wriggles slightly. Gentle handheld drift.
s028: The nurse holds her closed-lip smile and gently rocks the ginger cat in her arms while it blinks and looks around. Gentle handheld drift.
s029: The vet holds her closed-lip smile and shifts the tabby slightly in her arms while it blinks and looks around. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s032: The golden goo slowly oozes and settles over the teeth while the trapped bacteria pulse and drift inside it. Smooth slow lateral camera glide along the row of teeth.
s034: The bacteria inside the plaque fortress wriggle and pulse while the tiny flag flutters gently on top; the stone blocks stay solid. Smooth slow camera arc around the fortress.
s035: The spiky bacterium saws its legs back and forth into the gum while the red blood cell drifts slowly away. Smooth slow push-in.
s036: The swollen red bacterium pulses brighter and grows slightly larger, its legs twitching; the fortress behind stays still. Smooth slow camera pull-back.
s038: Glistening saliva washes slowly over the tooth, thinning and loosening the yellow plaque at its base. Smooth slow camera rise from the gumline toward the tip of the tooth.
s039: The tabby squirms and scrunches its face harder, pawing at the toothbrush and pulling its head back. Slightly shaky handheld camera, no zoom.
s040: The woman's thumb slowly strokes the cat's relaxed paws, which stay soft apart from a gentle toe flex. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s042: Mabel crunches her biscuits happily, jaw chewing steadily and ears relaxed, then dips in for another mouthful; the bowl stays still. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s044: Mabel kneads the pillow once and settles deeper, eyes slowly closing, while the woman smiles softly with lips closed. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s045: The hand gently strokes Mabel's back as she breathes slowly, her eyes closing contentedly and an ear twitching. Gentle handheld drift, very slow push-in.
s047: The fingers hold the lip gently while Mabel blinks calmly and her whiskers twitch; the pink gums stay in clear view. Slow handheld push-in toward the gums.
s048: The woman hugs Mabel a little closer and nuzzles her cheek against her head, eyes and lips closed, while Mabel blinks slowly. Gentle handheld drift.
s049: Mabel rubs her cheek slowly along the woman's face while the woman smiles wider, eyes and lips closed. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s052: The hand slowly turns the jaw model a few degrees, light gleaming across the white teeth. Gentle handheld drift.
s054: The cheerful green bacteria bob up and down and march slowly along the castle wall; the tooth and wall stay still. Smooth slow push-in.
s055: The brown bacteria shrink and pull away from the gum, which slowly turns less red; the tooth stays still. Smooth slow camera glide along the gumline.
s056: The brown plaque blobs slide slowly away from the base of the tooth and drift off; the tooth stays still and bright. Smooth slow push-in.
s058: Mabel nuzzles slowly against the woman's face and the woman smiles a little wider, eyes and lips closed. Gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s059: The fingers hold the cat's mouth gently open while it blinks calmly and its whiskers twitch; the gums stay in clear view. Slow handheld push-in.
s061: The instruments lie perfectly still on the drape while overhead light glints slowly across the steel. Slow handheld push-in.
s062: The drill tip moves slowly along the teeth in small, careful motions while the anaesthetised cat stays still, breathing gently. Gentle handheld drift.
s063: The black cat finishes its yawn, slowly closes its mouth and licks its lips, then blinks; the laptop stays still. Gentle handheld drift.
